_README: Every line, flavour, size and variant legible in the shop's own 48MP photographs, read frame by frame at native resolution. This is what is ON THE SHELF, not what the brands make - the difference is the entire point, and it is why nothing here should ever be topped up from a manufacturer's catalogue. A customer who drives over for something the shop never carried is worse off than one who saw a shorter list. `legibility`: clear = printed name read unambiguously, partial = most read and the rest a confident completion, inferred = packaging recognised but the name not actually legible.
